Inoperative, In So Far As The Property In Question i.e.,
Bearing Its Property No.2, House List No.72/1, Property
No.40/5B In Sy.No.40/5B, New Katha No.1610/72/40/5B/2
Situated At Hennur Village, Kasaba Hobli, Bangalore
North Taluk Totally Measuring 9000 Sq. Feet Consist Of 13
Square Rcc Roofed House Along With 4 Shops Measuring
60 X 17 Feet And Etc.,
 This Petition, Coming On For Preliminary Hearing In
B-Group, This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order
Learned counsel for petitioner has filed a memo dated 08.11.2023 seeking permission to withdraw writ petition on ground that O.S.no.26592/2014 filed by petitioner has been decreed.
3. In view of memo, writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
